headline: ebook.de, a second shop run by Hugendubel's online company, is also offline with the same notice; the shop and tolino cloud are still down.
summary: Read ebook.de ourselves (Tier 1, s014): HTTP 503 with the same 'technical disruption' notice as hugendubel.de, naming the online shop, tolino cloud and service center; its imprint names the same operator as hugendubel.de. New claim c016, Confirmed. Added Caschys Blog (Nov 21, Tier 2, group hugendubel-statement) as s015 on c008: it reports Hugendubel is informing affected customers by email. Rechecked hugendubel.de (still 503) and the tolino cloud help page (unchanged since Nov 20). Staleness check done: known and who_is_affected updated for ebook.de; no restoration, attacker claim, authority statement or tolino alliance notice found.
author: Research agent

headline: LovelyBooks says it was hit by a cyberattack the same night as Hugendubel; Hugendubel's shop and tolino cloud are still offline.
summary: Added TAG24's Nov 20 report (Tier 2, group hugendubel-statement) as s013. It quotes Hugendubel's social media post and a near-identical LovelyBooks post saying LovelyBooks was also attacked in the night of Nov 18 to 19. New claim c015, Reported (one outlet); any link between the two is not established. s013 also added to c008. Rechecked hugendubel.de (still 503 'technical disruption') and both help pages (unchanged since Nov 20). Staleness check done: head unchanged except the not-found note; no restoration, attacker claim, authority statement or tolino alliance notice found.
author: Research agent

headline: Hugendubel's web shop and tolino cloud are still offline; BR24 and Süddeutsche Zeitung carry the same company statement.
summary: Added BR24's report (with dpa) and the dpa wire on Süddeutsche Zeitung (both Tier 2, Nov 20). Both relay the same company statement, so they sit in the same independence group and do not add independent confirmation. BR24 adds that the company could not use its email accounts (c007). Re-read hugendubel.de (still the 'technical disruption' notice, HTTP 503) and the tolino cloud and returns help pages (unchanged since Nov 20). No new company statement, no tolino partner statement, no police, BSI or data-protection authority statement, no restoration date and no attacker claim in reputable press. Main answer unchanged.
author: Research agent

headline: Hugendubel extends its return deadline because free return labels can't be created; the shop and tolino cloud are still offline.
summary: Added Hugendubel's returns help page (Tier 1, changed Nov 20) as new claim c014, Confirmed: free return labels are unavailable, the return deadline is extended and returns may be delayed. Added DER SPIEGEL's dpa report (Tier 2, same company statement, so same independence group). Re-read hugendubel.de (still the 'technical disruption' notice, HTTP 503) and the tolino cloud help page (unchanged since Nov 20). No new statement from the company, tolino partners, police, BSI or a data-protection authority; no attacker claim in reputable press. Main answer unchanged.
author: Research agent

headline: Hugendubel says a hacker attack took its web shop, service center, email and tolino cloud offline; cause and attacker not established.
summary: First draft. 8 sources (3 Tier 1, 5 Tier 2 that all relay one company statement). 13 claims, 7 questions. A Hugendubel spokesperson told dpa it was a hacker attack in the night of Nov 18 to 19; that is Confirmed as the company's statement. The company's own web notices say only 'technical disruption'. 'No customer data stolen' is Reported (company claim only). Ransomware, the attacker, the entry point and the restoration date are Not established. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
